tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Keyword search over every GlobalHostia hosting, server, SSL and email plan, with filters for category, location and maximum monthly price. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything about one plan by slug: description, specs, included and excluded features, location, availability, and every billing cycle with its price, setup fee, monthly equivalent and cart link.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 plans by slug: specs, price for every billing cycle (with setup fee and monthly equivalent), location and top features. Use after search_products or recommend_plan when the user is choosing between options.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every product category with a one-line summary, number of plans, starting price and page link, plus all datacenter locations and supported currencies. Good for browsing or when a search returns nothing.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Live registry check of one domain name (e.g. mybrand.com, mybrand.ae): whether it is available, first-year registration price, renewal and transfer price, and an add-to-cart link. If taken, returns a link to the domain broker service. Limited to 10 checks per minute.

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Ready-to-pay cart deep link for one plan with the billing cycle and currency preselected, optionally attaching a domain to the hosting order. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_policies" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: GlobalHostia customer policies summarised from the published Terms & Conditions: money-back guarantee, domain and SSL refunds, cancellation, automatic renewal a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
